page.notes: Doubtful readings: "euentilemus" (main text, possibly euentilemus as printed); "nè ꝑ quidem" (the abbreviation after nè is uncertain); "Interp. Votum eccles." in the note for Onuphrius is partly unclear, and "Agrippa de vanitate scient." is read from a cramped note. The date cIɔccxcIV is read as MCCXCIV by the old-numeral rule. Marginal notes were placed directly after their reference marks in the text. The final word "ideò" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
